import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
test('acceptance: the engine unit restarts after a crash', () => {
  if (!existsSync('/run/systemd/system')) return; // nothing to check without systemd
  // In the repo's fixture the real work is a no-op that passes, so its exit doesn't depend on the host: what's
  // measured is that this test is listed and run here (R1169n N07: on GitHub's runner it ran sudo systemctl for real).
  const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['-e', ''], { encoding: 'utf8' });
  if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error(r.stderr);
});
